drop.name: CHEK Receipt Drop

x.name: X drop
x.entry: follow @chekcoinsol, repost a drop post, reply to it with your public Solana address, then paste the link to your reply at chekcoinsol.xyz/drop
x.check: the site checks that the link is a public reply to @chekcoinsol, written after the drop opened, that contains a valid Solana address; every drop post is its own round (one entry per account per round); one address per account and one account per address; follow and repost are asked, not checked

telegram.name: Telegram drop
telegram.entry: subscribe to t.me/chekcoinsol and leave your public Solana address in the comments under the pinned Telegram drop post (or send it to @chekcoinsol_bot) — one address per Telegram account, channel subscribers only

drop.separate: two separate drops with separate lists and separate draws — you can enter both
drop.source: the creator wallet’s own launch buy (bought on the curve like everyone; free allocation stays 0%)
drop.draw_rules: each X round closes 24 hours after its post and is drawn then; the Telegram drop closes 24 hours after launch; seed = the blockhash of the first Solana block with block time at or after the close; score = sha256(blockhash + ':' + address), the lowest scores win; inputs are published so anyone can re-check
drop.send: from the creator wallet after launch — within 48 hours of the launch or of the draw, whichever is later; every transfer published as an on-chain receipt
drop.condition: only if $CHEKD launches; the airdrops go to the first valid accounts in order, the draws are among valid entries
drop.never: no claim site, no wallet connect, no signing, no fees, no DMs from us
